gloss: like that; in that way; that's how

definitions.gloss: like that; in that way; doing it that way
definitions.explanation: Refers to a method the listener has just described or demonstrated. Often carries a mild criticism when it comments on a habit the speaker disapproves of.

examples.japanese: そうやって⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧んです⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: So that's how you make it.

examples.japanese: そうやって⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧んだ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧。
examples.english: You always run away like that.

examples.japanese: そうやって⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えて→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧いけば、いつか⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧⟦{話|はな}せる→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦ようになる→ようになる：28408_youninaru⟧。
examples.english: If you keep learning bit by bit that way, you'll definitely be able to speak someday.

notes:
Composed of そう (that way) + ⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧ (te-form of ⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧). Part of a demonstrative series with ⟦こうやって→こうやって：27245_kouyatte⟧ (this way, near the speaker) and ⟦ああやって→ああやって：30295_aayatte⟧ (that way, away from both).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- そうやって⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: looking at it that way
- そうやって⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧: always like that (usually a complaint)
- そうやって⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to keep going that way

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦こうやって→こうやって：27245_kouyatte⟧: like this — the method the speaker is showing
- ⟦ああやって→ああやって：30295_aayatte⟧: like that — a method neither person is doing right now
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in that way — the formal written equivalent
